summary: Invitation Homes Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of $500M aggregate principal amount of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2032 by its operating partnership, fully guaranteed by the company and affiliates. The notes are issued under an existing indenture with a supplemental indenture to follow. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction under an effective shelf registration. It is not a special situation. The filing simply documents an ordinary-course debt issuance.
